newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Part-time job rules spelt out; ministry decision allows 19 categories of employees to work in firms other than their original employers or sponsors.
- Arab League official says most Arabs oppose Qatar meeting.
- Emirates Group profits jump to 194.2 million dirhams in the year ending March 1997.
- Banks in UAE perform well last year, helped by an economy doing well, competition and effective regulations, study says.
- UAE and Morocco affirm excellent relations.
- Emirates Group posts big profits, announces bonus to employees.
- Dubai gold market looks ahead to recovery in Indian demand.
- Saudi Arabia affirms its support to Syria's stand on the Middle East peace process.
- Health insurance registers 100 growth in the past two years.
